description:
*Position is contingent upon contract award* 
 SOSi is seeking an Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (Al/ML) Engineer. The AI/ML Engineer shall design, develop, test, evaluate, and deploy Al/ML models and ensembles across various domains, including generative Al, classification, prediction, computer vision, natural language processing (NLP), and reinforcement learning. Al/ML engineering services will be provided to support Sponsor's initiatives, leveraging expertise in Al/ML algorithms, software development, and cloud computing.
 Essential Job Duties 
 Design and develop Al/ML models and ensembles using Sponsor's data and requirements.
 Preprocess, clean, and analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured Sponsor data to assess utility for Al model training and testing.
 Collaborate with staff officers to conceptualize, design, develop, and execute experiments verifying model performance and system soundness.
 Deploy and maintain Al/ML models and ensembles in cloud-based environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
 Develop and maintain extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipelines, SQL configurations, and
 performance metrics to support Al/ML applications.
 Document and communicate methods and findings using Sponsor's formats and templates, which could include authoring analytic publications, producing ad-hoc reports, creating data visualizations, delivering slideshow presentations or briefings, or documenting methods in GitHub repositories.
 Provide technical education to staff on an ad-hoc basis on AI/ML related topics.
 Provide subject matter expertise in Al/ML to support Sponsor's initiatives.
 
 Minimum Requirements 
 Active Top Secret Clearance. 
 Demonstrated professional experience with the following required tools, systems, services, and data types: Python or R programming languages for AI/ML development.
 Deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
 Version control systems, such as GitHub.
 Cloud computing services from major providers, including experience with cloud-based AI/ML development and deployment.
 AI/ML model development and deployment, including model turning, experimentation, validation, and benchmarking.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with AI/ML model explainability and interpretability techniques.
 Familiarity with Sponsor’s enterprise services, security controls, and data management practices.
 Experience with front-end web development frameworks, such as Flask.
 Experience with Tableau to produce visualizations and dashboards.
 Experience with verification and validation test benches.
 
 Work Environment 
 Working conditions are normal for an office environment.
 Fast paced, deadline-oriented environment.
 Working at SOSi 
 All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.
